title: Theta-Relations Among Degree-Based Tree Indices
summary: In this paper, degree-based topological indices play a key role in the structural analysis of graphs in this paper and have significant uses in chemical graph theory. We investigate the connections between three such tree indices: the Albertson, Sombor, and Sigma indices. We show that the quadratic degree deviation, measured by the Sigma index, tightly controls the Sombor index of a tree by establishing sharp two-sided bounds.
